Use this tool to notice patterns that can make your **window of tolerance narrower** and the things that can help **widen it or make it easier to return to**. The goal is a practical plan you can look at when your fuse feels short, you are overloaded, or you are starting to shut down.

[Learn about the Window of Tolerance](/learn/distress-tolerance/index.html#window-of-tolerance)

This tool is for reflection and planning. What helps can vary by person and by day; use your own experience and appropriate professional guidance when needed.
